premise.claim: KEP-531 (merged in #548) specifies component targeting and containerPatches for engine runtime profiles; main implements neither. The PR implements the KEP.
premise.reportedComponent: pkg/discovery engine-runtime render path + engineRuntimes API
premise.evidence: base ea5e82ae api/workloads/v1alpha2/rolebasedgroup_types.go EngineRuntime has only profileName/injectContainers/containers (no component/targetContainers); pkg/discovery/sidecar_builder.go has no targeting concept; keps/531-engine-runtime-profile-injection/README.md exists at base (merged via #548). Component match: PR touches exactly the KEP's named components (api surfaces, pkg/discovery render pipeline, reconcilers, CERP webhook/controller).
